data.name: Subtitle
data.value: How long does a player take to reach level X? Level curve, quest XP and a grind rate make the timeline.

data.name: NoCurves
data.value: No filled curve field in the project yet — the level curve is a field of type “formula/curve”, for example on a skill tree or a class.

data.name: CurveHint
data.value: The curve value at x is the XP for the step from level x to x+1.

data.name: QuestFieldHint
data.value: Summed over all quests — one-time XP that carries the first levels.

data.name: MobFieldHint
data.value: Averaged — XP per kill, times kills per hour makes the grind rate.

data.name: TimelineEmpty
data.value: Choose the sources on the left, then the simulation runs.

data.name: CurveEmpty
data.value: The chosen curve yields no positive values in its range — as a level curve it carries nothing.
